name: agents-library
description: Orchestrator skills for feature planning, PR review, design review, issue triage, issue filing, simplification, batch merging, codebase mapping, installing periodic maintenance agents, and a manager console that delegates work items to worker agents.

interface.shortDescription: Feature planning, coding review, and triage skills.
interface.longDescription: Agents Library provides Codex skills for planning features with acceptance criteria and tests; reviewing pull requests, visual design, and UX psychology; triaging issues; filing new issues from a description; batch-merging pull requests; simplifying code; mapping a codebase; installing the library's maintenance agents into a project on a periodic schedule; and turning a session into a manager console that delegates each work item to worker agents — independent plans, a SWOT merge, implementation, an independent review, and verified fixes — and tracks them on a status board without doing the work itself.
defaultPrompt: Plan a feature before we build it.
Triage open issues in this repo.
